Usage: claude plugin marketplace [options] [command]

Manage Claude Code marketplaces

Options:
  -h, --help        Display help for command

Commands:
  add <source>      Add a marketplace from a URL, path, or GitHub repo
  list              List all configured marketplaces
  remove|rm <name>  Remove a configured marketplace
  update [name]     Update marketplace(s) from their source - updates all if no
                    name specified
  help [command]    display help for command
